why: Alpöge, Bhargava, Ho and Shnidman (Jan 2025) show every quadratic extension of number fields yields a rank-stable positive-rank abelian variety, implying Hilbert's tenth problem is undecidable over the ring of integers of every number field; Koymans and Pagano independently obtained a related negative answer for all infinite finitely generated rings over Z around the same time.
